title: Conditional good minimal models for compact Kähler fourfolds
main_claim: Assume three things: orbifold Iitaka subadditivity, the pseudo-effective klt fourfold MMP, and abundance for nef fourfold adjoints with kappa >= 0. Then every globally strongly Q-factorial compact Kähler klt fourfold pair (X,B) with pseudo-effective Q-Cartier adjoint has a good minimal model. The new ingredient is nonvanishing kappa(Y,K_Y+Delta) >= 0 on the nef endpoint, proved by fibration arguments when a(W)>0 and by metric, foliation and reduced-boundary extension arguments when a(W)=0.

issues.location: Appendices proj:* (Theorem proj:conditional-log-abundance), used via Corollary red:projective in sections/reductions.tex
issues.description: Not a located error. The paper settles its projective (Moishezon) branch with a 4000-line appendix that proves projective log abundance in all dimensions. The appendix says it uses Iitaka subadditivity only with D_X=D_Y=0, and only for the Albanese reduction. If that is right, the appendix comes close to an unconditional proof of log abundance, which is an extraordinary claim, and the projective case of the main theorem depends entirely on it. I did not audit the appendices (signed descent, jets, Frobenius), so a gap there would carry straight through to Theorem thm:main.
issues.evidence: "In fact, the proof uses only D_X=D_Y=0, in the Albanese reduction in Appendix proj:sec:exclusions." (projective_introduction.tex); Corollary red:projective: "Apply that theorem, whose full proof is included in the appendices."

issues.location: Lemma met:zero-lelong, sections/minimal_metric.tex (Bochner step, eqs met:closed-test-estimate to met:residual-riesz)
issues.description: This is a new, dimension-independent theorem: the minimal-singularity metric of a nef klt adjoint has zero Lelong numbers. Both the K_T+G extension step and the empty-divisor case depend on it. I checked these computations and found them consistent: the differentiated Monge-Ampère equation, the h-bounds, the curvature of the weight P (dd^c P >= -dT using beta - theta >= 0), the density ratio exponents M_i+g_i >= 0, the log(1+|w|^2) identity (verified symbolically) and the final Lelong exponent (sC0*lambda - n)/(s(1+C0)). The L^2 solution with a non-semipositive weight (via the Riesz representation with a residual term) and the approximation of the W^{1,2} section are written very tersely, and I did not check every justification in them in full.
issues.evidence: "The residual derivative in this assertion is essential: the curvature lower bound in (met:bochner-curvature) is not semipositive."

coverage: Read line by line: introduction, premises, reductions (log-Iitaka from the orbifold version, Moishezon/Namikawa, uniruled and irregular lemmas, canonical reduction) and positive_dimension (pullback model via twisted K-MMP and Fujino's rationality bound; surface base with the fiber-power order m(rh-(r-1)(e-1)) and the Zariski/Riemann-Roch finish; threefold base with the genus-one Hodge line, modular-form growth, threshold t_P = 1 - l_P/m, crepant klt (T,Xi)). Also read all of minimal_metric, checking each estimate, with the log identity verified in sympy. Read completion: finite prime classes, eventual vanishing, ideal pushforward and Leray injection, DPS hard Lefschetz extension, the signed and unsigned canonical-frame cases, and the torsion-to-effective exceptional argument. Read the end of birational: canonical pseudo-effectivity transport, the reduced-boundary model (phase 1/2 and the t->1 zero-Lelong argument). In floor: quotient surface, horizontality and the r=0 non-Moishezon cycle root-of-unity argument. Skimmed only: the empty_divisor foliation/spherical-structure argument after the forms count, the rest of floor (projective clusters, r=1/2), dlt special termination in birational, and the projective appendices (not audited). Companion inputs (GrantMMP, GrantEffectiveAbundance, GrantCampana) taken as stated; their hypotheses match their use here, and the abundance companion requires no Q-factoriality.
